facts.note: Kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast, kept so on purpose so nothing is late.
Lina came down at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote: I went up to fetch Monsieur for the toast.
added.why: Rosa moved up to the atelier after the kitchen period and the hall clock strike, so her upstairs movement comes later in the sequence than the sheet's events.

added.quote: Madame had said the glasses were ready and he must come down.
added.why: Madame was somewhere in the house able to speak to Rosa before Rosa went upstairs, which gives an order between Madame's message and Rosa's climb.
